SELECT rc.loan_id, rc.as_of_date
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.grade_name = '次级'
ORDER BY rc.loan_id ASC;

SELECT payment_id, business_date, amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE is_cash = 1
  AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT card_id, issued_on, expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = '贷记卡'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, op.operating_status
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
  AND op.registered_region = (
      SELECT ou.region_code
      FROM organization_unit ou
      WHERE ou.unit_name = '上海分行'
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN account a ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY account_count DESC;

SELECT
    s.sector_name_zh,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN industry_sector s
    ON ca.target_industry_code = s.sector_code
GROUP BY s.sector_code, s.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs
    ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       cs.net_capital,
       cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
ORDER BY cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       SUM(abs.ledger_balance) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs ON abs.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = '储蓄'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) AS avg_principal_overdue_days
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN loan_drawdown l ON l.loan_id = d.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY avg_principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS exposure_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital AS exposure_to_capital_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY exposure_to_capital_ratio DESC;

WITH loan_industry AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        op.industry_code
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
),
latest_classification AS (
    SELECT
        rc.loan_id,
        rc.grade_code
    FROM risk_classification rc
    JOIN (
        SELECT loan_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM risk_classification
        GROUP BY loan_id
    ) latest ON latest.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND latest.max_date = rc.as_of_date
)
SELECT
    isec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(li.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lc.grade_code IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lc.grade_code IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(li.loan_id) AS npl_ratio
FROM loan_industry li
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = li.industry_code
LEFT JOIN latest_classification lc ON lc.loan_id = li.loan_id
GROUP BY isec.sector_code, isec.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(li.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY npl_ratio DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) AS product_count, AVG(management_fee_rate) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product
GROUP BY risk_level
ORDER BY risk_level ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = '有效'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS 合同金额合计
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS record_count,
       SUM(d.observed_value) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = d.institution_id
WHERE d.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
WHERE r.deadline_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets <> 0
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds
    ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc
    ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg
    ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_name IN ('正常', '关注')
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
      FROM risk_classification rc2
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS under_provisioned_loan_balance
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND lbs.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY under_provisioned_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    s.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN party p
    ON p.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op
    ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector s
    ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND s.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 违规流入金额,
    SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS 指令金额合计,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS 占比
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector s ON op.industry_code = s.sector_code
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on,
    wp.actual_termination_on
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs
    ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.actual_termination_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_agreement_count
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc
    ON ptc.payment_type = pe.payment_type
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou
    ON ou.org_unit_id = pe.origin_org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = '已清算'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    borrower_sector.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    target_sector.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p
    ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op
    ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_sector borrower_sector
    ON borrower_sector.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN industry_sector target_sector
    ON target_sector.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code <> op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    from_holder.party_id AS from_party_id,
    to_holder.party_id AS to_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder from_holder
    ON from_holder.account_id = pe.from_account_id
    AND from_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder to_holder
    ON to_holder.account_id = pe.to_account_id
    AND to_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON (
        (pr.source_party_id = from_holder.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = to_holder.party_id)
        OR
        (pr.source_party_id = to_holder.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = from_holder.party_id)
    )
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event p
JOIN account a ON p.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sm.staff_id,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so
    ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm
    ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN account_holder ah
    ON pe.to_account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p
    ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op
    ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec
    ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY txn_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    c.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    c.event_date,
    c.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(c.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 c
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id
WHERE c.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    cl.security_id,
    cl.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE ca.status = 'RELEASED'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY cl.security_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    so.covered_amount
FROM loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN credit_agreement AS ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation AS so
    ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement AS sa
    ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY so.covered_amount DESC;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ld.disbursed_amount AS principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status <> 'CLOSED'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.institution_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lb.institution_id
            ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC, lb.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance lb
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    r.loan_id,
    r.principal_balance,
    r.rn AS balance_rank
FROM ranked r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.target_industry_code,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ca.target_industry_code
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.target_industry_code,
        lb.principal_balance,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lb.target_industry_code ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC) AS rnk
    FROM loan_balance lb
)
SELECT
    isec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name_zh,
    r.loan_id,
    r.principal_balance,
    r.rnk
FROM ranked r
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = r.target_industry_code
WHERE r.rnk <= 3
ORDER BY isec.sector_name_zh ASC, r.rnk ASC;

SELECT
    business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
    COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS txn_count_change
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS principal_balance,
    avg_amt.avg_amount AS institution_avg_balance,
    ld.disbursed_amount - avg_amt.avg_amount AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca2.institution_id, AVG(ld2.disbursed_amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id
) avg_amt ON ca.institution_id = avg_amt.institution_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount > avg_amt.avg_amount
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl
    ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) <= 0 THEN '未逾期'
        WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
        WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
        WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
        WHEN julianday('now') - julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
        ELSE '360天以上'
    END AS overdue_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'SETTLED')
GROUP BY overdue_bucket
ORDER BY
    CASE overdue_bucket
        WHEN '未逾期' THEN 0
        WHEN '1-30天' THEN 1
        WHEN '31-90天' THEN 31
        WHEN '91-180天' THEN 91
        WHEN '181-360天' THEN 181
        WHEN '360天以上' THEN 361
    END;

SELECT collateral_id, as_of_date, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM collateral_valuation
GROUP BY collateral_id, as_of_date
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_principal,
    AVG(ld.disbursed_amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY avg_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cash_payment_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_member sm
    ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN service_operator so
    ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
   AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY cash_payment_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    AVG(pp.annual_income) AS avg_annual_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS high_income_ratio
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH account_primary_holder AS (
    SELECT ah.account_id, ah.party_id
    FROM account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
      AND ah.effective_from = (
          SELECT MIN(ah2.effective_from)
          FROM account_holder ah2
          WHERE ah2.account_id = ah.account_id
            AND ah2.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
      )
),
payment_with_holders AS (
    SELECT
        p.payment_id,
        p.amount,
        p.from_account_id,
        p.to_account_id,
        fa.institution_id AS from_institution_id,
        ta.institution_id AS to_institution_id,
        fh.party_id AS from_party_id,
        th.party_id AS to_party_id
    FROM payment_event p
    LEFT JOIN account fa ON fa.account_id = p.from_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account ta ON ta.account_id = p.to_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_primary_holder fh ON fh.account_id = p.from_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_primary_holder th ON th.account_id = p.to_account_id
),
payment_related AS (
    SELECT
        pw.payment_id,
        pw.amount,
        COALESCE(pw.from_institution_id, pw.to_institution_id) AS institution_id,
        CASE
            WHEN pw.from_party_id IS NOT NULL
             AND pw.to_party_id IS NOT NULL
             AND EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1
                 FROM party_relation pr
                 WHERE pr.source_party_id = pw.from_party_id
                   AND pr.target_party_id = pw.to_party_id
                   AND pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
             )
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END AS is_related
    FROM payment_with_holders pw
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pr.is_related = 1 THEN pr.amount ELSE 0 END) AS related_amount,
    SUM(pr.amount) AS total_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pr.is_related = 1 THEN pr.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pr.amount) AS related_ratio
FROM payment_related pr
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = pr.institution_id
WHERE pr.institution_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY related_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = ah.account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY term_deposit_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)) AS avg_age_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_age_days DESC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
    JOIN (
        SELECT loan_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot
        GROUP BY loan_id
    ) latest ON lb.loan_id = latest.loan_id AND lb.as_of_date = latest.max_date
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        lbs.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN (
        SELECT loan_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot
        GROUP BY loan_id
    ) latest ON lbs.loan_id = latest.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = latest.max_date
),
industry_balance AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(org.industry_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS industry_code,
        SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_balance lb
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    LEFT JOIN organization_profile org ON p.party_id = org.party_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(org.industry_code, 'UNKNOWN')
),
with_names AS (
    SELECT
        ib.industry_code,
        COALESCE(ist.sector_name_zh, ist.sector_name_en, ib.industry_code) AS industry_name,
        ib.total_balance
    FROM industry_balance ib
    LEFT JOIN industry_sector ist ON ib.industry_code = ist.sector_code
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC, industry_name) AS running_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER () AS grand_total
    FROM with_names
)
SELECT
    industry_name,
    total_balance,
    (running_balance * 1.0 / grand_total) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM cumulative
WHERE (running_balance * 1.0 / grand_total) <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 未结清借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ld.status <> 'CLOSED'
  AND ld.closed_on IS NULL
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 未结清借据笔数 DESC;

WITH latest_valuation AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount
    FROM (
        SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY collateral_id ORDER BY valued_on DESC, valuation_id DESC) AS rn
        FROM collateral_valuation
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    lv.valuation_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN latest_valuation lv ON lv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE lv.valuation_amount > sa.secured_amount * 2
ORDER BY (lv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND a.institution_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 1
ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT from_account_id AS account_id,
       business_date,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM payment_event
WHERE from_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY txn_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0) AS total_balance
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_balance DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) AS security_count,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) > 1
   AND SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN credit_agreement AS ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution AS i
    ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = '受托支付'
  AND ld.status = '有效'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lb.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lb.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lb.overdue_since) AS INTEGER) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    pi.instruction_amount,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower
    ON borrower.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN payment_instruction pi
    ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN party payee
    ON payee.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = '受托支付'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement AS ca
JOIN party AS p
    ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
  AND p.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.product_family,
    ca.target_industry_code,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN credit_agreement AS ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN industry_sector AS isec
    ON isec.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.product_family = '流动资金类'
  AND isec.risk_category = '退出类'
  AND ld.status = '正常'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ld.disbursed_amount AS principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
),
institution_avg AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        AVG(principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_balance
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    lb.loan_id,
    lb.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_balance,
    lb.principal_balance - ia.avg_balance AS excess_amount
FROM loan_balance lb
JOIN institution_avg ia ON ia.institution_id = lb.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = lb.institution_id
WHERE lb.principal_balance > 2 * ia.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.source_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
    ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) AS non_related_amount,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.source_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
    ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS ratio
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT
        cs.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    JOIN (
        SELECT institution_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM capital_snapshot
        GROUP BY institution_id
    ) t ON t.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND t.max_date = cs.as_of_date
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    lb.total_balance,
    lc.net_capital,
    lb.total_balance * 1.0 / lc.net_capital AS ratio
FROM loan_balance lb
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = lb.institution_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = lb.borrower_party_id
JOIN latest_capital lc ON lc.institution_id = lb.institution_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
  AND lc.net_capital > 0
  AND lb.total_balance * 1.0 / lc.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg AS (
    SELECT
        target_industry_code,
        AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
)
SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS 执行年利率,
    ia.avg_rate AS 所属目标行业平均利率,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 1.0 / ia.avg_rate * 100, 2) AS 较行业平均上浮百分比
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_avg ia ON ia.target_industry_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ia.avg_rate > 0
  AND ca.annual_interest_rate > ia.avg_rate * 1.1
ORDER BY 较行业平均上浮百分比 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH loan_principal AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'WRITTEN_OFF')
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT
        cs.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    JOIN (
        SELECT institution_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM capital_snapshot
        GROUP BY institution_id
    ) t ON t.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND t.max_date = cs.as_of_date
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS over_limit_customer_count
FROM loan_principal lp
JOIN latest_capital lc ON lc.institution_id = lp.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = lp.institution_id
WHERE lc.net_capital > 0
  AND lp.principal_balance * 1.0 / lc.net_capital > 0.10
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY over_limit_customer_count DESC;

WITH group_loan AS (
    SELECT
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        SUM(lb.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm
        ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca
        ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
       AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld
        ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb
        ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
cap AS (
    SELECT
        cs.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    JOIN (
        SELECT institution_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM capital_snapshot
        GROUP BY institution_id
    ) latest
        ON latest.institution_id = cs.institution_id
       AND latest.max_date = cs.as_of_date
)
SELECT
    g.exposure_group_id,
    g.group_name,
    g.total_balance,
    c.net_capital,
    g.total_balance * 1.0 / c.net_capital AS ratio
FROM group_loan g
JOIN cap c
    ON c.institution_id = g.institution_id
WHERE g.total_balance * 1.0 / c.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement AS ca
JOIN loan_drawdown AS ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = '已到期'
  AND ld.status = '正常'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS interval_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON pe.from_account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) BETWEEN 0 AND 7
ORDER BY interval_days ASC, pe.amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH latest_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
    JOIN (
        SELECT loan_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot
        GROUP BY loan_id
    ) t ON lb.loan_id = t.loan_id AND lb.as_of_date = t.max_date
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT cs.institution_id, cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    JOIN (
        SELECT institution_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM capital_snapshot
        GROUP BY institution_id
    ) t ON cs.institution_id = t.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = t.max_date
),
borrower_loan AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(llb.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN latest_loan_balance llb ON llb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_name,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        bl.total_principal * 1.0 / lc.net_capital AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY bl.institution_id
            ORDER BY bl.total_principal * 1.0 / lc.net_capital DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM borrower_loan bl
    JOIN latest_capital lc ON lc.institution_id = bl.institution_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = bl.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = bl.borrower_party_id
    WHERE lc.net_capital IS NOT NULL AND lc.net_capital <> 0
)
SELECT institution_name, customer_name, ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lb.loan_id
            ORDER BY lb.as_of_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
),
loan_with_institution AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        lb.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN latest_balance lb ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lb.rn = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        institution_id,
        NTILE(4) OVER (
            PARTITION BY institution_id
            ORDER BY principal_balance DESC
        ) AS quartile
    FROM loan_with_institution
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 本金余额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id) * 100, 2) AS 占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC, 占比 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 累计放款金额,
    ld.status AS 借据状态,
    SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS 逾期本金合计,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 逾期期次数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = '正常'
  AND pi.status = '逾期'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(pi.instruction_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 逾期期次数 DESC, 逾期本金合计 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT loan_account_id, disbursed_on, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY loan_account_id, disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT sm.person_party_id AS staff_party_id
FROM staff_member sm
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.party_id = sm.person_party_id
  )
ORDER BY sm.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
WHERE a.account_kind = '储蓄'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM payment_event AS p
      WHERE p.from_account_id = a.account_id
        AND p.is_cash = 1
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC;

WITH loan_maturity AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        CAST(julianday(current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') AS INTEGER) AS remaining_days
    FROM loan_drawdown
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN remaining_days < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN remaining_days <= 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS maturity_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_maturity
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY
    CASE maturity_bucket
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS related_count
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN security_agreement sa
    ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE cl.status = '有效'
  AND sa.status = '有效'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) > 1
ORDER BY related_count DESC;

SELECT
    collateral_type AS 押品种类,
    AVG(collateral_value) AS 平均评估价值,
    COUNT(*) AS 评估笔数
FROM private_credit_profile
WHERE collateral_type IS NOT NULL
  AND collateral_value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY collateral_type
ORDER BY 平均评估价值 DESC;

WITH loan_repay_account AS (
    SELECT
        ld.repayment_account_id AS repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id AS loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on AS disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount AS disbursed_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
account_loan_count AS (
    SELECT
        repayment_account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_repay_account
    GROUP BY repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) >= 3
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        lra.repayment_account_id,
        lra.loan_id,
        lra.disbursed_on,
        lra.disbursed_amount,
        alc.loan_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lra.repayment_account_id
            ORDER BY lra.disbursed_on ASC, lra.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_repay_account lra
    JOIN account_loan_count alc
        ON alc.repayment_account_id = lra.repayment_account_id
)
SELECT
    repayment_account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    disbursed_amount,
    loan_count
FROM ranked_loans
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id ASC, disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS 累计放款金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS 超合同投放金额,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 放款笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    SUM(abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) AS total_difference
FROM account_balance_snapshot abs
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE abs.available_balance IS NOT NULL
  AND abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
  AND (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_difference DESC;

SELECT
    td.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit AS td
JOIN account AS a
    ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC, card_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = '受托支付' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS entrusted_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = '自主支付' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS self_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = '受托支付' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING entrusted_ratio < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ld.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) * 100, 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) > 0.9
ORDER BY ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) AS total_actual_raise,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_planned_raise,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completion_rate
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

WITH loan_status AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_overdue
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id AS borrower_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ls.has_overdue = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_loan_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_loan_count
FROM loan_status ls
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ls.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ls.has_overdue = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN ls.has_overdue = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC, borrower_id ASC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id AS 支付指令编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    borrower.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    payee.display_name AS 实际收款人名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN party payee
    ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id <> ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN credit_agreement AS ca
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.signed_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id AS loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS unsettled_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM repayment_schedule AS rs
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'SETTLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER BY total_principal_due DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(abs.ledger_balance, 2) AS ending_principal,
    ROUND(abs.debit_balance, 2) AS ending_overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs
    ON abs.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
WHERE ld.status = '核销'
  AND abs.ledger_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY abs.ledger_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN account AS a
    ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursement_account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND a.opened_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown AS ld
JOIN account AS a
    ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = '储蓄类'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.security_type AS 担保方式,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称
FROM credit_agreement AS ca
JOIN party AS p
    ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = '信用'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id THEN pr.target_party_id
            ELSE pr.source_party_id
        END AS related_party_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    JOIN credit_agreement ca
      ON ca.borrower_party_id IN (pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id)
    WHERE pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
),
borrower_related AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN party_relation pr
      ON pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
     AND (
          (pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND pr.target_party_id IS NOT NULL)
          OR
          (pr.target_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND pr.source_party_id IS NOT NULL)
         )
),
product_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
)
SELECT
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.borrower_party_id AS customer_id,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS contract_rate,
    pa.avg_rate AS product_avg_rate,
    (pa.avg_rate - ca.annual_interest_rate) AS rate_spread
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN borrower_related br
  ON br.borrower_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party p
  ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN product_avg pa
  ON pa.institution_id = ca.institution_id
 AND pa.product_family = ca.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.annual_interest_rate < pa.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id AS 关联方甲方编号,
    pr.target_party_id AS 关联方乙方编号,
    rtc.relation_name_zh AS 关联关系名称
FROM party_relation AS pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog AS rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement AS ca
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement AS ca
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
  )
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh ASC, pr.relation_id ASC;

WITH member_loans AS (
    SELECT
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm
        ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca
        ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
        AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld
        ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
        ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
),
capital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
)
SELECT
    ml.group_name,
    ml.member_count,
    ml.total_principal,
    c.net_capital,
    (ml.total_principal * 1.0 / c.net_capital) AS ratio
FROM member_loans ml
JOIN capital c
    ON c.institution_id = ml.institution_id
WHERE c.net_capital IS NOT NULL
  AND c.net_capital <> 0
  AND (ml.total_principal * 1.0 / c.net_capital) > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH payment_parties AS (
    SELECT
        p.payment_id,
        p.amount,
        p.from_account_id,
        p.to_account_id,
        from_holder.party_id AS from_party_id,
        to_holder.party_id AS to_party_id
    FROM payment_event p
    JOIN account_holder from_holder
      ON from_holder.account_id = p.from_account_id
     AND from_holder.holder_role IN ('OWNER', 'PRIMARY', 'HOLDER', 'ACCOUNT_HOLDER')
    JOIN account_holder to_holder
      ON to_holder.account_id = p.to_account_id
     AND to_holder.holder_role IN ('OWNER', 'PRIMARY', 'HOLDER', 'ACCOUNT_HOLDER')
    WHERE p.from_account_id IS NOT NULL
      AND p.to_account_id IS NOT NULL
      AND p.status = 'COMPLETED'
),
related_pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pr.source_party_id AS party_a,
        pr.target_party_id AS party_b
    FROM party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
      AND pr.relation_type IS NOT NULL
      AND pr.relation_type <> ''
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pr.target_party_id AS party_a,
        pr.source_party_id AS party_b
    FROM party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type <> '非关联方'
      AND pr.relation_type IS NOT NULL
      AND pr.relation_type <> ''
)
SELECT
    from_party.display_name AS payer_name,
    to_party.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
    SUM(pp.amount) AS total_amount
FROM payment_parties pp
JOIN related_pairs rp
  ON rp.party_a = pp.from_party_id
 AND rp.party_b = pp.to_party_id
JOIN party from_party
  ON from_party.party_id = pp.from_party_id
JOIN party to_party
  ON to_party.party_id = pp.to_party_id
GROUP BY
    pp.from_party_id,
    pp.to_party_id,
    from_party.display_name,
    to_party.display_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product AS wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot AS phs
    ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset AS ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot
WHERE investment_path = '多层中介产品'
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS book_principal_balance,
    MAX(ld.days_past_due) AS max_days_past_due
FROM loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount > 90000000
  AND ld.days_past_due IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.days_past_due > 0
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount
HAVING MAX(ld.days_past_due) >= 200
ORDER BY max_days_past_due DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(abs.debit_balance, 0)) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN account_holder ah
    ON ah.party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN account a
    ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs
    ON abs.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE abs.debit_balance > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    COALESCE(g.guarantee_total, 0) AS 对外担保合计,
    COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0) AS 自身借款合计,
    COALESCE(g.guarantee_total, 0) - COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
JOIN (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id, SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS guarantee_total
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) g ON g.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id, SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS loan_total
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) l ON l.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
  AND COALESCE(g.guarantee_total, 0) > COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0)
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    sm.staff_id AS 员工编号,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 授信合同笔数
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p
    ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 授信合同笔数 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS 本金余额合计,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    so.operator_id AS 操作员编号,
    so.authority_level AS 权限级别,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = '信贷经办员'
GROUP BY so.operator_id, p.display_name, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS staff_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account_holder ah
    ON ah.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
JOIN staff_member sm
    ON sm.person_party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN party p
    ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 个人年收入,
    SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS 应还本息总额,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, 借款人客户编号 ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    lpc.product_name_zh AS product_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_family = ca.product_family
WHERE ld.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY overdue_principal_total DESC;

WITH deposit_pools AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        CASE
            WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 'expired'
            WHEN julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN 'within_90'
            ELSE 'over_90'
        END AS pool
    FROM term_deposit td
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
    WHERE a.institution_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pool = 'expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pool = 'within_90' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pool = 'over_90' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_count
FROM deposit_pools
GROUP BY institution_id, institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pool = 'expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN account a
    ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN account_holder ah
    ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count,
    SUM(abs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM account_balance_snapshot abs
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
WHERE abs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_period_count,
    SUM(principal_due) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        principal_due
    FROM repayment_schedule
    WHERE status = 'OVERDUE'
      AND due_date < DATE('now')
) t
GROUP BY loan_id
HAVING SUM(principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(rs.interest_due) AS total_interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    installment_no,
    principal_due,
    interest_due
FROM (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        installment_no,
        principal_due,
        interest_due,
        due_date,
        paid_principal,
        paid_interest,
        status
    FROM loan_repayment_schedule
) AS schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY principal_due DESC;

WITH facility_total AS (
    SELECT institution_id, SUM(limit_amount) AS total_limit
    FROM credit_facility
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
loan_total AS (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
capital_latest AS (
    SELECT cs.institution_id, cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    JOIN (
        SELECT institution_id, MAX(as_of_date) AS max_date
        FROM capital_snapshot
        GROUP BY institution_id
    ) m ON cs.institution_id = m.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = m.max_date
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ft.total_limit,
    lt.total_disbursed,
    cl.net_capital,
    ROUND(lt.total_disbursed * 1.0 / cl.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN facility_total ft ON i.institution_id = ft.institution_id
JOIN loan_total lt ON i.institution_id = lt.institution_id
JOIN capital_latest cl ON i.institution_id = cl.institution_id
WHERE lt.total_disbursed > cl.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = '保证担保'
  AND gc.status = '有效'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    cf.facility_id,
    cf.limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM credit_facility AS cf
JOIN status_catalog AS sc
    ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement'
   AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE cf.facility_type = '循环授信'
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit_amount
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i
    ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY
    cf.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT facility_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

SELECT
    CASE payment_mode
        WHEN 'LUMP_SUM' THEN '一次性还本付息'
        WHEN 'INSTALLMENT' THEN '分期还款'
        WHEN 'INTEREST_ONLY' THEN '按期付息到期还本'
        WHEN 'EQUAL_PRINCIPAL' THEN '等额本金'
        WHEN 'EQUAL_INSTALLMENT' THEN '等额本息'
        WHEN 'REVOLVING' THEN '循环还款'
        WHEN 'BULLET' THEN '到期一次性还本'
        ELSE payment_mode
    END AS payment_mode_name,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY payment_mode
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        minimum_holding_days,
        actual_raise_amount,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS grp
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = '在售'
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT
        grp,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM ranked
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY grp
)
SELECT grp, product_count
FROM grouped
WHERE product_count BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY grp ASC;

SELECT
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_revolving_limit,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS disbursement_count
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = '循环授信'
  AND ld.payment_mode = '受托支付'
GROUP BY cf.facility_id
ORDER BY total_revolving_limit DESC;

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc
    ON pmc.payment_mode = pi.payment_mode
JOIN status_catalog sc
    ON sc.entity = 'payment_instruction'
   AND sc.status_code = pi.status
WHERE sc.name_zh = '待执行'
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY pending_instruction_count DESC;

SELECT ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name_zh,
       sc.name_zh AS status_name_zh
FROM payment_type_catalog ptc
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY ptc.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count
FROM organization_unit AS ou
JOIN staff_assignment AS sa
    ON sa.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE sa.role_code = '信贷客户经理'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY credit_manager_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name,
    rc.overdue_days,
    rc.overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE rc.overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_name = '正常'
ORDER BY rc.overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.loan_id) AS undercovered_loan_count
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown l ON l.loan_id = p.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE p.provision_stage = '2'
  AND p.required_amount > 0
  AND (p.recognized_amount * 1.0 / p.required_amount) < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY undercovered_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS total_provision_gap
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_provision_gap DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    abs.balance AS ledger_balance
FROM account AS a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot AS abs
    ON abs.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.status = '久悬'
  AND a.account_kind = '储蓄'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account_holder AS ah
      WHERE ah.account_id = a.account_id
        AND ah.holder_role = '次要持有人'
  )
ORDER BY abs.balance DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile AS pp
JOIN party AS p
    ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    ma.asset_category_primary AS asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM managed_asset AS ma
WHERE ma.asset_scope = '受托管理资产'
  AND ma.industry_code IN (
      SELECT sector_code
      FROM industry_sector
      WHERE risk_category = '受限'
  )
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.obligor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, 客户编号 ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
GROUP BY pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, pp.occupation_code ASC, pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT status AS card_status, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = '借记卡'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, card_status ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a
    ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc
    ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN party p
    ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou
    ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM payment_event AS pe
JOIN payment_card AS pc
    ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pc.holder_party_id AS holder_party_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cash_txn_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_cash_amount
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN account a
    ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
   AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY cash_txn_count DESC, total_cash_amount DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号, COUNT(*) AS 发卡数量
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY 发卡数量 DESC, 持卡人编号 ASC;

SELECT
    pc.card_type AS 银行卡类型名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS 平均单笔金额
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE pc.card_type IN ('贷记卡', '借记卡')
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.card_type
ORDER BY 平均单笔金额 DESC, 银行卡类型名称 ASC;

SELECT
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    AVG(amount) AS average_amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE status = 'SETTLED'
  AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY channel
HAVING AVG(amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY average_amount DESC, channel ASC;

SELECT
    td.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM term_deposit AS td
JOIN account AS a
    ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND td.maturity_on < DATE('now')
  AND a.status = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    MAX(ce.valuation_amount) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_evaluation ce
    ON ce.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
GROUP BY
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS reference_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_link cl
    ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY reference_count DESC, ca.collateral_id ASC;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ca.agreement_id AS agreement_id,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(lt.total_disbursed, 2) AS total_disbursed
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN security_agreement sa
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
JOIN secured_obligation so
    ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN loan_totals lt
    ON lt.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p
    ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = '有效'
  AND gc.guaranteed_amount > lt.total_disbursed
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, p.party_id ASC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH valid_agreement AS (
    SELECT
        ca.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.contract_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND (ca.effective_to IS NULL OR ca.effective_to >= date('now'))
),
valid_security AS (
    SELECT
        sa.security_id
    FROM security_agreement sa
    WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND (sa.effective_to IS NULL OR sa.effective_to >= date('now'))
),
coverage AS (
    SELECT
        so.agreement_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(so.covered_amount, 0)) AS total_covered
    FROM secured_obligation so
    JOIN valid_security vs ON vs.security_id = so.security_id
    WHERE so.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (so.effective_to IS NULL OR so.effective_to >= date('now'))
    GROUP BY so.agreement_id
)
SELECT
    va.agreement_id,
    va.borrower_party_id,
    va.contract_amount,
    COALESCE(c.total_covered, 0) AS total_covered,
    va.contract_amount - COALESCE(c.total_covered, 0) AS coverage_gap
FROM valid_agreement va
LEFT JOIN coverage c ON c.agreement_id = va.agreement_id
WHERE va.contract_amount - COALESCE(c.total_covered, 0) > 0
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC, va.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS underprovisioned_loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = rc.as_of_date
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY underprovisioned_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS obligor_party_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    abs(COALESCE(ld.disbursed_amount, 0)) AS loan_balance,
    ca.contract_amount AS contract_amount,
    ROUND(ABS(COALESCE(ld.disbursed_amount, 0)) * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_multiple
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.contract_amount > 0
  AND ABS(COALESCE(ld.disbursed_amount, 0)) >= 4 * ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY balance_multiple DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_provision AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        rc.grade_code,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        ld.status AS loan_status,
        ld.exception_flag AS loan_exception_flag
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
),
provision_calc AS (
    SELECT
        lp.loan_id,
        lp.institution_id,
        lp.grade_code,
        lp.disbursed_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN lp.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN lp.disbursed_amount * 0.25
            ELSE 0
        END AS required_provision
    FROM loan_provision lp
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name,
    COUNT(*) AS over_provision_count,
    SUM(pc.actual_provision - pc.required_provision) AS over_provision_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        lp.loan_id,
        lp.institution_id,
        lp.grade_code,
        lp.disbursed_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN lp.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN lp.disbursed_amount * 0.25
            ELSE 0
        END AS required_provision,
        COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(ar.amount)
            FROM asset_resolution_event ar
            WHERE ar.loan_id = lp.loan_id
              AND ar.event_type = 'PROVISION'
        ), 0) AS actual_provision
    FROM loan_provision lp
) pc
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = pc.institution_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = pc.grade_code
WHERE pc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS')
  AND pc.actual_provision > pc.required_provision
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name
ORDER BY over_provision_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC, cg.grade_name ASC;

WITH internal_eval AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(pledged_amount) AS max_internal
    FROM collateral_link
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
),
external_eval AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(pledged_amount) AS max_external
    FROM collateral_link
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(ie.max_internal, 2) AS max_internal_value,
    ROUND(ee.max_external, 2) AS max_external_value,
    ROUND(ie.max_internal - ee.max_external, 2) AS undervaluation_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN internal_eval ie ON ca.collateral_id = ie.collateral_id
JOIN external_eval ee ON ca.collateral_id = ee.collateral_id
WHERE ee.max_external < ie.max_internal
ORDER BY undervaluation_gap DESC;

WITH latest_valuation AS (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        asset_label,
        currency_code,
        fair_value AS latest_value
    FROM (
        SELECT
            ca.collateral_id,
            ca.asset_label,
            ca.currency_code,
            mp.fair_value,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY ca.collateral_id
                ORDER BY mp.as_of_date DESC, mp.position_id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM collateral_asset ca
        JOIN market_position mp
          ON mp.instrument_id = ca.collateral_id
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
pledged AS (
    SELECT
